# HRNECK — HRNECK Training Portal

Security awareness training platform for MSPs and organizations.

## Public surfaces
- Home: /
- Sign in: /login
- Operator guides hub: /docs
- Getting started: /docs/getting-started
- Dashboard guide: /docs/dashboard
- Targets & groups guide: /docs/targets-groups
- Training guide: /docs/training
- Checklists guide: /docs/checklists
- Ticketing guide: /docs/ticketing
- Reporting guide: /docs/reporting
- Users & roles guide: /docs/users-roles
- Announcements guide: /docs/announcements-notifications
- Settings guide: /docs/settings

## Authenticated surfaces
- MSP portal: /msp
- Organization admin: /org
- Training hub: /org/training
- Training campaigns: /org/training/campaigns
- Targets and groups: /org/targets
- Users: /org/users
- Roles: /org/roles
- Reports: /org/reports
- Report export: /org/reports/export
- Settings: /org/settings
- Checklists: /org/checklists
- Checklist instances: /org/checklists/instances
- Ticketing queue: /org/ticketing
- Ticketing desks: /org/ticketing/desks
- Ticketing KB: /org/ticketing/kb
- Ticketing email: /org/ticketing/email
- Ticketing reports: /org/ticketing/reports
- Ticketing search: /org/ticketing/search
- Service portal tickets: /portal/tickets
- Service portal KB: /portal/kb
- Learner portal: /learn
- Platform Filament admin: /admin (API host)

## Local development hosts
- Tenant hosts use `{slug}.hrneck.test` in local development.
- Demo credentials: admin@hrneck.test (password from API `.env.example`).
- Production: https://hrneck.com/
